SELECT a.id, a.title, a.slug, a.summary, a.cover_image AS coverImage, a.content_html AS contentHtml, a.status, a.review_status AS reviewStatus, a.review_comment AS reviewComment, a.reviewed_at AS reviewedAt, a.submitted_at AS submittedAt, a.reviewer_name AS reviewerName, a.published_at AS publishedAt, a.author_id AS authorId, u.display_name AS authorDisplayName, u.avatar_url AS authorAvatarUrl, u.avatar_object_key AS authorAvatarObjectKey, a.created_at AS createdAt, a.updated_at AS updatedAt, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(urh.view_count) FROM user_reading_history urh WHERE urh.target_type = 'ARTICLE' AND urh.target_id = a.id AND urh.deleted = 0 ), 0) AS viewCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_article_favorites uaf WHERE uaf.article_id = a.id AND uaf.deleted = 0 ), 0) AS favoriteCount, 0 AS likeCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_comments ac WHERE ac.article_id = a.id AND ac.parent_id IS NULL ), 0) AS commentCount FROM articles a LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.author_id AND u.deleted = 0
a.deleted = 0
AND (a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND a.status = #{status}
ORDER BY
commentCount viewCount a.updated_at a.id commentCount
ASC DESC , a.id DESC
